purpose: Initial audited seed list for the MajorRSS Source Preset Library.
notes: The official preset library is layered. General baseline sources should provide broad coverage even without vertical packs.
Vertical packs should add depth for technology, economy, politics, medicine, academia, AI, and similar domains.
Built-in sources prioritize official RSS/Atom feeds and stable GitHub release feeds.
Third-party generated feeds are separated from official feeds even when their content originates from official sites.
Web page candidates should be monitored by page_diff or a generated-feed pipeline before promotion.

collections.title: General Baseline
collections.description: Broad official source baseline. A user can enable only this collection and still get useful general world, business, politics, and public-interest coverage.

collections.title: Regional Perspectives Baseline
collections.description: Mainstream sources from different countries and regions to reduce single-region bias in the broad baseline.

collections.title: Market and Economy Baseline
collections.description: Broad official finance and economy feeds for users who need market-moving context before deeper vertical packs.

collections.title: Financial Institutions Research
collections.description: Public insights and research pages from investment banks and asset managers. Public metadata and short summaries only; do not redistribute paid or licensed reports.

collections.title: Healthcare and Medicine
collections.description: Public health, medical regulation, and biomedical research sources for health-related monitoring.

collections.title: Academic Research
collections.description: General academic and scientific sources. Use with domain keywords or narrower user-defined sources for niche fields.

collections.title: Policy and International Organizations
collections.description: Government and international organization feeds for policy, diplomacy, trade, and regulation tracking.

collections.title: Cybersecurity Watch
collections.description: Official and high-signal security feeds for vulnerabilities, threat intelligence, incidents, and security policy.

collections.title: Crypto and Web3 Watch
collections.description: Crypto assets, Bitcoin, blockchain infrastructure, Web3 security, exchanges, and compliance. This overlaps finance, security, and regulation but remains separate to avoid polluting the general finance feed.

collections.title: AI People Radar
collections.description: High-signal AI researchers, founders, and lab leaders. This is intentionally separate from official lab feeds because personal accounts can be noisy.

collections.title: Tech Founders People Radar
collections.description: High-impact technology founder and operator accounts. Useful but noisy; best paired with task-level filters.

collections.title: Crypto People Radar
collections.description: High-signal crypto and Web3 people accounts.

collections.title: Frontier Model Labs
collections.description: High-signal updates from frontier AI labs and model providers.

collections.title: AI Infra Radar
collections.description: AI infrastructure, model serving, GPU, developer tools, and framework updates.

collections.title: Developer Tools Changelog
collections.description: Low-noise product and release updates for developer tools.

collections.title: AI Papers
collections.description: Core arXiv category feeds for AI, ML, NLP, and computer vision.

collections.title: Regulatory Radar
collections.description: Selected official finance, policy, standards, and cybersecurity announcement feeds.

collections.title: AI Service Status
collections.description: Official service-status feeds for AI platforms. Keep separate from news feeds.
